## Motivation

People differ in how they prepare coffee, what they say they like, and
how they rate the coffee they taste. We want to explore whether
respondents' stated preferences and self-rated coffee expertise are
associated with their ratings of four coffee samples.

## Data source

We will use the [May 14, 2024 TidyTuesday Coffee Survey](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2024/2024-05-14).
The dataset includes respondents' coffee habits, stated preferences,
self-rated expertise, and tasting ratings for samples A through D.

## Planned analyses and visualizations

We will summarize brewing methods and stated roast preferences with
bar charts. We will compare the distributions of sample preference
ratings and explore whether rating patterns vary by expertise or
stated roast preference. Our main data-cleaning tasks will be
separating multiple-response survey fields, reshaping the tasting
ratings to one row per respondent per sample, and checking how many
respondents rated all four samples.

## Final products

We plan to produce a written report, a project website with selected
visualizations, and a short screencast summarizing our findings.
